title: "02_Train_MOFA2_model_GENCODEv47"
output: html_document

## Purpose

Trains the MOFA2 model on the views prepared by script 01. This version trains the **restricted-RNA model**: the RNA view contains only protein-coding, IG/TR and non-antisense annotated lncRNA genes from the original top 5000 (see the filtering criteria at the top of script 01). Model settings are identical to the original model, so differences between the two models come from the RNA gene set only.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Maximum factors | 10 |
| Factor-drop threshold | 0.02 (a factor is dropped if it explains < 2% variance in every view) |
| Likelihoods | RNA and CNV Gaussian; WES and IMPACT mutation views Bernoulli |
| View scaling | `scale_views = FALSE` |
| Convergence mode / maximum iterations | medium / 1000 |
| Seed | 42 |
| Model tag | `K10_drop02_seed42_GENCODEv47_restrictedRNA` |
| Python backend | mofapy2 0.7.3 (MOFA2 R package 1.22.1), set directly with reticulate |

The RNA view is named `RNA_VST_restricted` (set in script 01) and contains the filtered genes.

```{r paths}
# Restricted-RNA analysis: same folder as script 01
OUT_DIR   <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2/Biased_analysis"
RDS_DIR   <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_RDS")
TABLE_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Tables")
MODEL_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Model")
PLOT_DIR  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Plots")
for (d in c(RDS_DIR, TABLE_DIR, MODEL_DIR, PLOT_DIR)) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Output of 01_Prepare_MOFA2_input_GENCODEv47.Rmd
VIEW_MATRIX_RDS <- file.path(RDS_DIR, "MOFA2_prepared_input_view_matrices_GENCODEv47.rds")

# ---- Settings ----
MAX_FACTORS    <- 10
DROP_THRESHOLD <- 0.02   # drop factors explaining < 2% variance
MODEL_TAG <- "K10_drop02_seed42_GENCODEv47_restrictedRNA"

# Python with mofapy2 (matches the installed MOFA2 R package); used instead of basilisk
MOFA_PYTHON <- file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".cache/R/basilisk/1.24.0/MOFA2/1.22.0/mofa_env/bin/python")
if (!file.exists(MOFA_PYTHON)) stop("Python for mofapy2 not found: ", MOFA_PYTHON)

MODEL_OUTFILE     <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_pILC_model_", MODEL_TAG, ".hdf5"))
TRAINED_MODEL_RDS <- file.path(RDS_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_pILC_model_", MODEL_TAG, "_trained.rds"))
```

```{r load-and-check-views}
if (!file.exists(VIEW_MATRIX_RDS)) stop("Prepared input not found: ", VIEW_MATRIX_RDS)
view_mats <- readRDS(VIEW_MATRIX_RDS)

expected_views <- c("RNA_VST_restricted", "WES_CNV_numeric",
                    "WES_mutation_recurrent", "IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB")
missing_views <- setdiff(expected_views, names(view_mats))
if (length(missing_views) > 0) stop("Missing view(s): ", paste(missing_views, collapse = ", "))

view_mats <- view_mats[expected_views]
valid <- vapply(view_mats, function(x) is.matrix(x) && nrow(x) > 0 && ncol(x) > 0, logical(1))
if (!all(valid)) stop("Empty/invalid view(s): ", paste(names(view_mats)[!valid], collapse = ", "))

view_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
  m <- view_mats[[v]]
  data.table(view = v, n_features = nrow(m), n_samples = ncol(m),
             n_non_missing_values = sum(is.finite(m)), n_missing_values = sum(!is.finite(m)))
}))
print(view_summary)
fwrite(view_summary, file.path(TABLE_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_training_input_view_summary_", MODEL_TAG, ".tsv")), sep = "\t")
```

```{r sample-view-presence}
sample_view_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
  data.table(sample = colnames(view_mats[[v]]), view = v, present = 1)
}))
sample_summary <- dcast(sample_view_dt, sample ~ view, value.var = "present", fill = 0)
view_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sample_summary), "sample")
sample_summary[, n_views_present := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = view_cols]
sample_summary <- sample_summary[order(-n_views_present, sample)]
print(sample_summary)
fwrite(sample_summary, file.path(TABLE_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_training_sample_view_presence_", MODEL_TAG, ".tsv")), sep = "\t")

if (sample_summary[n_views_present >= 2, .N] == 0) stop("No samples shared across >= 2 views. Check sample IDs.")
```

```{r long-format}
matrix_to_long <- function(mat, view_name) {
  dt <- as.data.table(as.table(mat))
  setnames(dt, c("feature", "sample", "value"))
  dt[, `:=`(sample = as.character(sample), feature = as.character(feature),
            view = view_name, value = as.numeric(value))]
  dt[is.finite(value), .(sample, feature, view, value)]
}

mofa_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) matrix_to_long(view_mats[[v]], v)), use.names = TRUE)
mofa_dt <- mofa_dt[, .(sample, feature, view, value)]

fwrite(mofa_dt, file.path(TABLE_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_training_input_long_format_", MODEL_TAG, ".tsv")), sep = "\t")
saveRDS(mofa_dt, file.path(RDS_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_training_input_long_format_", MODEL_TAG, ".rds")))
```

```{r create-mofa-object}
MOFAobject <- create_mofa(as.data.frame(mofa_dt))
print(MOFAobject)

pdf(file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_training_data_overview_", MODEL_TAG, ".pdf")), width = 8, height = 5)
print(plot_data_overview(MOFAobject))
dev.off()
```

```{r options}
data_opts <- get_default_data_options(MOFAobject)
data_opts$scale_views <- FALSE      # keep Bernoulli (0/1) views binary

model_opts <- get_default_model_options(MOFAobject)
model_opts$num_factors <- MAX_FACTORS

# RNA and CNV are Gaussian; mutation views are Bernoulli
view_likelihoods <- c(RNA_VST_restricted     = "gaussian",
                      WES_CNV_numeric        = "gaussian",
                      WES_mutation_recurrent = "bernoulli",
                      IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB = "bernoulli")
view_likelihoods <- view_likelihoods[names(model_opts$likelihoods)]   # match MOFA view order
if (anyNA(view_likelihoods)) {
  stop("Could not match likelihoods to views: ", paste(names(model_opts$likelihoods), collapse = ", "))
}
model_opts$likelihoods <- view_likelihoods

train_opts <- get_default_training_options(MOFAobject)
train_opts$convergence_mode      <- "medium"
train_opts$maxiter               <- 1000
train_opts$verbose               <- TRUE
train_opts$seed                  <- MODEL_SEED
train_opts$drop_factor_threshold <- DROP_THRESHOLD

print(data_opts); print(model_opts); print(train_opts)
```

```{r prepare-and-train}
MOFAobject <- prepare_mofa(MOFAobject, data_options = data_opts,
                           model_options = model_opts, training_options = train_opts)

reticulate::use_python(MOFA_PYTHON, required = TRUE)
print(reticulate::py_config())   # python: must be the mofa_env path above
MOFAobject.trained <- run_mofa(MOFAobject, outfile = MODEL_OUTFILE, use_basilisk = FALSE)
saveRDS(MOFAobject.trained, TRAINED_MODEL_RDS)
print(MOFAobject.trained)
```

```{r trained-overview-and-summary}
pdf(file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_trained_model_data_overview_", MODEL_TAG, ".pdf")), width = 8, height = 5)
print(plot_data_overview(MOFAobject.trained))
dev.off()

factor_scores <- as.data.table(get_factors(MOFAobject.trained, factors = "all", as.data.frame = TRUE))
retained_factors <- unique(as.character(factor_scores$factor))
retained_factors <- retained_factors[order(as.integer(sub("^Factor", "", retained_factors)))]

training_summary <- data.table(
  Metric = c("Views used", "Unique samples across views", "Samples in >= 2 views",
             "Initial maximum factors", "Factor-drop threshold", "Retained factors",
             "Retained factor names", "Seed", "Model file", "Trained RDS"),
  Value = c(paste(names(view_mats), collapse = "; "), uniqueN(mofa_dt$sample),
            sample_summary[n_views_present >= 2, .N], MAX_FACTORS,
            "0.02 (2% variance explained)", length(retained_factors),
            paste(retained_factors, collapse = "; "), MODEL_SEED,
            MODEL_OUTFILE, TRAINED_MODEL_RDS)
)
print(training_summary)
fwrite(training_summary, file.path(TABLE_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_training_summary_", MODEL_TAG, ".tsv")), sep = "\t")
```
